claim_piece: parent-owned Z_Q_eff and alpha readout descent
formal_statement: Let q_obs: P -> O be the observed quotient, v in ker(Dq_obs), and theta_rep, mu_rep fixed representation/readout-scale data. If Z_Q_eff(Phi)=Zbar(q_obs(Phi),theta_rep,mu_rep) with Z_Q_eff>0 and alpha_read(Phi)=Abar(q_obs(Phi),theta_rep,mu_rep,Zbar), then D_v ln Z_Q_eff=0 and D_v ln alpha_read=0.
proof_or_reason: D_v ln Z_Q_eff = D ln Zbar[Dq_obs(v),Dtheta(v),Dmu(v)]/Zbar = 0. The readout derivative vanishes by the same factorisation. No cancellation or fitting is used.
consequence: This is the clean theorem-zero route for local alpha drift and readout drift.
missing_for_claim: parent-owned q_obs; fixed theta/mu; full Z_Q_eff factorisation; readout factorisation

claim_piece: source/current readout must be the same branch
formal_statement: If S_src descends through q_obs and J_Q is obtained by varying that same descended action with respect to A_Q before readout, then source alpha coefficients cannot be introduced as separate readout-only couplings.
proof_or_reason: A single action gives one Maxwell source current and one Hilbert stress owner; a separate source-only normalisation would define a different branch.
consequence: This is what prevents WEP/R10 alpha products from being silently imported from the clock branch.
missing_for_claim: single descended total source action; same A_Q/g_obs/coframe variation; boundary/domain silence

claim_piece: effective action and spectroscopy reduction must be natural on quotient objects
formal_statement: If RG/matching/readout maps are natural transformations on the quotient category, then renormalized Z_Q_eff^eff and alpha spectra still factor through q_obs and fixed representation data.
proof_or_reason: A quotient-only input to a natural functor cannot acquire hidden representative dependence; any non-natural threshold/readout term is a retained residual, not a theorem-zero.
consequence: This blocks the common cheat where a clean bare action is used while loop/readout terms reopen alpha drift.
missing_for_claim: radiative closure; threshold-source ownership; clock/material spectroscopy readout factorisation

claim_piece: absolute alpha is not predicted by the descent theorem
formal_statement: The theorem zeros D_v ln alpha_read. It does not determine the universal measured value of alpha unless C_P, N_Q, lambda_A, current normalisation, hbar*c convention, and readout convention are all parent-fixed.
proof_or_reason: A universal constant can be calibrated without local drift. A value prediction needs more parent data than a drift-zero theorem.
consequence: Keeps the branch serious: local tests can close before absolute alpha is derived, but cannot be advertised as alpha prediction.
missing_for_claim: parent value of C_P N_Q; no/fixed lambda_A; current/readout convention; spectrum/hbar*c descent

claim_piece: contract written but not strict-current signed
formal_statement: The sufficient contract is now exact, but the current corpus does not sign parent norm descent, no hidden-visible coefficient morphisms, radiative/readout naturality, same-current total source ownership, or arena projection maps.
proof_or_reason: The proof is real; the missing signatures are not cosmetic. Adopting them without derivation would be a closure axiom.
consequence: Therefore local alpha/WEP/R10/clock claims stay closed; finite product acquisition remains the fallback.
